title: Independently prove real MCP invocation
notes: TesterCodex now independently extracts real MCP tool invocations directly from Codex stream events and raw stdout.
Tester self-reported tools_called in response JSON is treated as non-authoritative.
Observed MCP tool invocations must contain the expected MCP tool for the scenario event (e.g. mesa_remember, mesa_recall, mesa_improve, mesa_forget).
Missing or mismatched MCP tool invocations fail closed as infra_error.
